stem: Which statement describes another way that this interaction between the Texas paintbrush and other plants helps the Texas paintbrush survive in its environment?

options.label: A
options.text: The Texas paintbrush is protected from animals that feed on plants.

options.label: B
options.text: The Texas paintbrush slows the growth of nearby plants so that it has plenty of room to grow.

options.label: C
options.text: The Texas paintbrush grows during different times of the year than nearby plants do.

options.label: D
options.text: The Texas paintbrush increases in its attractiveness to bees and other pollinators that help it reproduce.
